pages.text: Geometry, symmetry and shape: the mathematics of space, and of the extra dimensions Physics needs.

$(thing)Euclid's Elements$(): the $(item)Geometer's Table$() finds π as Archimedes did, from a polygon inside a circle. Set its sides and the care of the straightedge; the error must be under the recipe's tolerance. It makes $(item)π Crystals$(), one of the five constants of Euler's identity. Its calibration: fill a vertex with regular polygons.

$(thing)Groups and Symmetry$(): the $(item)Symmetry Lathe$() turns a blank with k-fold rotation and k mirrors, a group of order 2k that must be the recipe's. $(item)Symmetry Crystals$(), then $(item)Lie Group Lattices$() ($(thing)Lie Groups$()), which make Quaternion Crystals and Gauge Boson Clusters far more cheaply. Its calibration: complete a symmetric pattern. Its indexing head is a $(item)Symmetry Seed$() (crafted).

$(thing)Topology of Surfaces$(): the $(item)Topology Kiln$() fires surfaces with handles and cross-caps. Euler's χ = 2 − 2g − c and one-sidedness must be the recipe's: Möbius strips, Klein bottles, differential manifolds and Calabi-Yau manifolds, by new routes far cheaper than the old ones.
Compactification now needs $(thing)Manifolds and Curvature$(), and Grand Unification needs $(thing)Lie Groups$().
